elaine: Hey — I pushed the fixes for the config parsing nits from last review. PTAL when you have a minute.

mike: ack, thanks. quick question — did you keep the old backward-compatible flag path?

elaine: yes, left the flag `--legacy-config` in and added a migration comment. small snippet:
```
if (opts.legacy) { loadLegacy(); } else { loadV2(); }
```

raj: will run the smoke locally in a few. CI is currently backed up cause of the nightly k8s job, but i can kick a re-run if it flakes.

ci-bot: Build #5421 finished: FAILED — test_read_config (timeout)

mike: hmmm the timeout is flaky. Elaine can you add a small wait/retry in the test or mark as flaky?

elaine: added a retry with 100ms backoff and pushed. also added a short note in the PR description about risk and rollback plan.

mike: Nice. Can you PTAL to the commit message? I'd like a short changelog line for release notes.

elaine: done.

mike: ok — I can give the second approval and nominate a merge slot if raj's smoke passes. Raj? 

raj: smoke passed locally. CI rerun is green now.

mike: sweet. I'll approve and ask ops to slot it for the 11:30 canary. Elaine — want me to merge or do you prefer to land?

elaine: go ahead and merge. please squash and keep the two-part commit message.

mike: merging in 5. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: Merge queued by mike. Deploy scheduled for 11:30 canary window.
